definitions.gloss: setting up, installation, preparation of a site
definitions.explanation: The act of setting up a camp, tent, event venue, or facility. Often used for temporary installations.

examples.japanese: テントを{設営|せつえい}する。
{会場|かいじょう}の{設営|せつえい}を{手伝|てつだ}った。
examples.english: I helped set up the venue.

examples.japanese: イベント{前日|ぜんじつ}にスタッフ{全員|ぜんいん}で{設営|せつえい}{作業|さぎょう}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: All staff worked together on setup the day before the event.

notes:
{設営|せつえい} means setting up or installing a temporary facility, camp, venue, or similar structure. It combines {設|せつ} (establish) with {営|えい} (operate/camp).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- テントを{設営|せつえい}する: to set up a tent
- {会場|かいじょう}の{設営|せつえい}: venue setup
- {設営|せつえい}{作業|さぎょう}: setup work
- {基地|きち}を{設営|せつえい}する: to set up a base
- {設営|せつえい}{班|はん}: setup team/crew

OPPOSITE:
- {撤収|てっしゅう}: teardown, striking camp, withdrawal

USAGE:
Often used for temporary installations (events, camping, military operations). For permanent construction, {建設|けんせつ} or {設置|せっち} are more appropriate.
